title: feat(report): add HTML report output
problem: There is no self-contained HTML report for sharing with stakeholders who do not use a terminal.
why: A browsable report improves communication and review.
scope: Add `--format html` producing a single self-contained file with no external resources.
Escape all source-derived text to prevent HTML/script injection.
guidance: Template from findings; inline CSS only; no JavaScript or network fetches.
acceptance: Injection tests for crafted evidence strings
security: Treat all finding text as untrusted; escape it. No remote resources (CSP-friendly).
deps: May add a small templating crate or use string joining.

title: feat(report): add JUnit XML output for CI test reporters
problem: CI systems that consume JUnit XML cannot display findings as test cases.
why: JUnit output integrates with many existing dashboards without custom parsing.
scope: Add `--format junit` mapping findings to test cases by rule and location.
guidance: One test case per finding; failures only for high/critical.
acceptance: Valid JUnit XML produced and validated in tests

title: feat(report): include suppressions and remediation metadata in SARIF
problem: SARIF output omits suppression state and some rule help metadata, limiting code-scanning integration.
why: Richer SARIF improves GitHub code-scanning UX and dedupe.
scope: Emit `suppressions` for suppressed findings and add `help` markdown to rule metadata.

title: feat(report): group terminal findings by file with code frames
problem: Findings are listed flat, making it hard to understand context within a file.
why: Grouped output with a few lines of surrounding code speeds up review.
scope: Group findings by file and show a bounded excerpt around each finding.
Keep excerpt size small and truncate long lines safely.
guidance: Reuse the original source text already read during parsing; do not re-read files in rules.
security: Never print more of the file than necessary; avoid exposing unrelated secrets present in source.

title: feat(report): publish and validate a JSON Schema for reports
problem: Consumers have no machine-checkable contract for the JSON report shape.
why: A schema prevents accidental breaking changes and helps downstream tooling.
scope: Commit a JSON Schema for the report under `docs/schema/`.
Add a test that validates a real report against the schema.
guidance: Keep the schema versioned and referenced from docs.
deps: Adds a JSON Schema validation dev-dependency.

title: feat(report): add severity summary and top rules to Markdown reports
problem: Markdown reports list findings but do not summarize the most common rules or categories.
scope: Add a "Top rules" and "Categories" summary section.
guidance: Compute counts deterministically and sort by count then id.
